mapper.select: SELECT p.cinema_id, c.multiplex_id, c.area_id, c.cinema_name, c.cinema_addr, COUNT(*) AS post_count, SUM(p.like_count) AS total_like FROM post p JOIN cinema c ON p.cinema_id = c.cinema_id WHERE p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY p.cinema_id, c.multiplex_id, c.area_id, c.cinema_name, c.cinema_addr ORDER BY post_count DESC, total_like desc limit 5;

SELECT (SELECT post_id FROM post WHERE post_id < #{postId} ORDER BY post_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS prev_id, (SELECT post_id FROM post WHERE post_id > #{postId} ORDER BY post_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS next_id, p.*, c.cinema_name, c.cinema_addr FROM post p JOIN cinema c ON p.cinema_id = c.cinema_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}

#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (commenter_id, post_id, content) VALUES (#{commenterId}, #{postId}, #{content})
INSERT INTO post (author_id, multiplex_id, area_id, cinema_id, screen_id, title, content) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{multiplexId}, #{areaId}, #{cinemaId}, #{screenId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET multiplex_id = #{multiplexId}, area_id = #{areaId}, cinema_id = #{cinemaId}, screen_id = #{screenId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: select p.post_id, m.multiplex_name, c.cinema_name , s.screen_name, p.cinema_id, p.screen_id, p.author_id, p.content, p.created_at from post p, multiplex m, cinema c, screen s where p.multiplex_id = m.multiplex_id and p.cinema_id = c.cinema_id and p.screen_id = s.screen_id order by created_at desc limit 3;
